spectral_comparisons.description: Source-linked joint visual comparisons of Raman/FTIR spectra across samples or plotted series.

scientific_analyses.description: Source-linked general scientific analyses across Result Units and evidence modalities.

figure_candidates.description: Ingest-detected source figure candidates, including vector-only plots rasterized with page-coordinate provenance and explicitly triaged.

numeric_value.description: Canonical machine-readable measurement value for this observation. A numeric string is accepted and must parse to a finite number. Qualitative descriptions and unrelated digits must not be placed here.

numeric_values.description: Machine-readable measurement values when an observation carries a transcribed series or multiple readings. Each entry must parse to a finite number. Use instead of embedding values only in description text.

measurand.description: One named quantity/analyte/parameter per numeric observation.

source_cell_or_row.description: Optional source table row/cell locator; evidence_refs remain mandatory.
